profile: DRAFT Core transcription of user-supplied Schema prose; not submitted or signed by Schema. Design acceptance only; independent source/signature audit not performed.

answers.answer: Required positive finite caller snapshot/cache/atom/digit limits and nonnegative scale; default SchemaQueryLimits invalid with explicit validation. Exact-decimal coefficient-digit/scale capacity precedes normalization; formatting has explicit output capacity. No implicit workload default or unlimited fallback. Workload ceiling selection is R4. Parsing/arithmetic/casts/map keys/serialization/wrong-kind/narrowing controls remain R3. The prose does not independently verify every one of the six member declarations; retain prior numeric detail only on owner confirmation.

Retain list shape including empty/singleton, per-atomic actual type/provenance and union-member distinctions. Nil and no-typed-value stay distinct. Bounded decimal-leaf/element-only-root evidence does not qualify wider list/union/nil/full-XSD behavior. Original versus fresh-construction evidence remains distinct; wider implementation is R3/R4.

Known N1-N8 requirements remain mapped to authority/advisor/context/episode/lifetime shapes. Unsupported operations report Unsupported rather than false or empty success. Within the described design scope no concrete R2 API/policy or source-feasibility blocker remains identified. Wider supported answers and refusal coverage remain R3/R4.

Compatibility is directional across source, target and environment with Compatible, Incompatible and Unsupported outcomes. Copies, QNames, digests and labels are not proof. Actual positive and negative proofs remain R3/R4; no general runtime compatibility is qualified.

proposedCarryForwardForConfirmation.deltaApplicabilityVerbatim: R01: capture is an XSLT output route and does not widen Schema numeric or compatible-view support. R02: principal/secondary serialized output, properties and messages are not typed XDM values or PSVI and must not be used to infer Schema provenance. R03: preserve original provider failures and keep them separate from typed-value/assessment outcomes; a captured output does not convert Unsupported or Invalid into success. R04: existing finite snapshot/atom/digit/scale controls are design intents, not selected workload defaults; parsing, arithmetic, map-key work and serialization need bounded policy, while no new Schema-specific capture limit is accepted here. R05: typed values and their provider evidence are borrowed within the exact admitted operation; capture does not transfer authority or extend resource lifetime. R06: raw exception graphs remain local diagnostics and are not traversed or serialized as schema evidence. R07: Core cost measurements are observations, not accepted Schema performance budgets; actual Schema numeric, list/union and compatibility workloads remain unqualified. R08: this is Revise for the exact design review; no public SDK/runtime support, C45, API freeze or product release acceptance is implied.
proposedCarryForwardForConfirmation.originalExceptionGraphDispositionVerbati: Exception, Data and InnerException graphs are local diagnostic references only, not immutable/detached schema evidence and not safe for IPC. Preserve object identity and aggregate boundaries for local diagnosis; do not recursively inspect provider objects, treat exception payloads as schema facts, or traverse nodes after admission revocation. Do not serialize or publish raw exception graphs. Any external diagnostic projection requires a separate owner-controlled bounded allowlist/redaction policy. Exception retention does not establish typed-value validity, authority, compatibility or successful cleanup.
